what: SPRT 1 of 2 (2026-09-30): the human-regularised root solve (piKL, lambda 0.03) against plain gen5, both on ROTOM's adaptive clock at the ladder target (14 s). Approved by Will 2026-09-30 ('1 2'). Written BEFORE the first game and never revised after one.
why: Phase B (docs/_reports/2026-09-30-human-regularised-phase-b.md, abra/regmc 1.48.0): lambda 0.03 passed not-lose at 2 s (0.515 [0.446, 0.583]) and 14 s (0.525 [0.456, 0.593], clock ratio 1.000), Protect fail rate 10.1% vs 16.9%. A screen pass is 'not shown to lose'; this SPRT asks whether it is STRONGER. That report's OWED section names the test but gives no command, so the protocol below is the brief's.
code: worktree branch worktree-agent-a53483ec982dfb1a1 at main 5eca2c42 (abra/regmc 1.48.0). main is NOT merged during the run: another agent is changing the arena to play real stat spreads, and this run plays the arena exactly as it is at 5eca2c42.
engine_release: eaa5becc54eb (the gate also passes on 97451d5fbf40; eaa5becc54eb is kept for comparability with the phase B screens, which were played on it)

arms.both: the same arms as the 14 s screen: gen5 MAG/DODUO/PORYGON2, k 4x4, depth 0, 1 reserved switch row, budgetMs 5000 cap, adaptive { targetMs 14000, credit0Ms 4667 }. X adds "kl": 0.03.

sprt.unit: pair of games on one battle seed, seats swapped

seed_note: NEW: phase B used 29501-29504; 30001 appears nowhere else in solver/ or docs/.
expected_wall: the 14 s screen took 8,440 s for 200 games on 4 workers; sprt.js allows at most 3, so up to about 31 h if it runs to 2,000 games.

reading_rule.when: ONCE, after sprt.js stops (a bound crossed or the game budget spent). sprt.js prints no interim LLR; nothing is read before the stop. A run stopped by anything else (a pause, a crash, a kill) is VOID and is re-run from this file with the same seed.
reading_rule.verdict: sprt.js verdict: H1 (X stronger by elo1 accepted), H0 (elo0 accepted), or INCONCLUSIVE (2,000 games, no bound).
reading_rule.clock: solver/machamp/sprt_read.js on the result: clock ratio = clock.x_ms.mean / clock.y_ms.mean over the counted games. The comparison is equal-clock only if the ratio is <= 1.10. Above 1.10 an H1 is NOT a strength claim and is reported as VOID-BY-CLOCK.
reading_rule.capability: X's KL solve must prove it ran: summed over the workers' last rows, ctr.kl['gen5-kl03-adaptive-14s'].decisions > 0, else VOID. missMe (a decision whose anchor fell back to uniform) is counted and reported; the run is VOID if missMe exceeds 1% of X's KL decisions. (Phase B's missMe = 0 clause was per 200-game screen; at up to 2,000 games a single anchor miss is expected by chance and is not a defect of the solve, so the bound is a share, stated here before any game.)
reading_rule.errors: errored pairs are excluded by sprt.js and counted; the run is VOID if they exceed 5% of the pairs used. Agent fallbacks (ctr.fallbacks) and MILTANK prior fallbacks (fallback_decisions) are read and stated.
reading_rule.also_read_not_bars: solver/arena/protect_read.js on the counted pairs: Protect share, fail rate, consecutive share, double share per arm. The expected direction, stated before the run: X at or below Y on share and fail rate. The ladder clock rule breaches (sprt_read.js: decisions over the per-turn max, games over the starting bank) are stated. None of these decides the verdict.
reading_rule.ci_caption: the Wilson 95% interval at the stop is conditional on a data-dependent stopping time and slightly optimistic.

on_H1: report only. Nothing goes onto a ladder arm; that is Will's call even on H1.
on_H0_or_inconclusive: report only; the flag stays off and on no arm.
